title: Logic under scripts/ lives in src/ behind the layer boundaries
body:
Why: architecture audit: scripts/ holds 60 files / 9881 lines (successor-launch.ts 954, fast-check.ts 488) outside scripts/boundaries.ts, which checks src/ only; src/core is 13 lines of types guarding nothing (KRN-05).
Outcome: hook and CLI logic moves to src/ modules (scripts/ keeps thin entry points under 100 lines); src/core either gains the task/finish-gate contract or is folded away with KRN-05 amended.
Proof: no scripts/**/*.ts above 100 lines; boundaries check covers the moved code.
Scope: scripts/, src/, test/, AGENTS.md.
Amendment A5 (fable-plan 2.3, AR:253): priority P3, after t-nfjxshj.
